@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+import re
+
+ALIAS = re.compile(r"^([A-Za-z]+)+$")
+
+
+def accepted_alias(value: str) -> bool:
+    if len(value) > 256:
+        return False
+    return ALIAS.fullmatch(value) is not None

ground_truth.rationale: A 256-character attacker-controlled alias ending in a nonletter forces exponentially many partitions of the nested + quantifiers before failing. The length cap does not make this practical to run safely.
